entries.subject: Cheng, Li & Yang (2026), The Astrophysical Journal Letters 998, 6: diameter about 700 km for an assumed albedo of 0.13
entries.finding: Illustrative sphere 700 km across, the diameter Cheng, Li & Yang estimate from its brightness for an assumed albedo of 0.13. The size is not measured.

entries.subject: JPL Horizons elements and independent vectors
entries.finding: Horizons' Sun-centred osculating elements at 2026-09-03 place the body and draw its orbit; the README states how far the far end can differ from the barycentric orbit papers quote.

entries.subject: cssEarth missing-coverage grid as the surface
entries.finding: No surface imagery exists for this body, so the page shows the missing-coverage grid with Shadows off.

entries.subject: Discovery paper discussion of the proposed distant planet
entries.finding: Cheng, Li & Yang discuss this orbit as a challenge to the proposed Planet Nine; the question is disputed, so no text or chart presents it.
entries.revisitWhen: A distant planet is found or the clustering question is settled in the literature.
